commonInstructions: A graphic display calculator and clean AI formula booklet are required on every paper.
Answer every question, showing mathematical working, reasoning and contextual interpretation.
Give exact answers where appropriate, otherwise three significant figures unless a question specifies another accuracy.
State units, define variables and use the stated modelling domain.
AI papers have no AA-style Section A/Section B split.
Numerical GDC solutions need equations, bounds, graphs, test definitions or other suitable mathematical working; do not write brand-specific calculator button instructions.

2.AHL 2.9: logistic, logarithmic, shifted sinusoidal and piecewise models

4.SL 4.11: chi-square and pooled two-sample t tests
4.AHL 4.12: data design, reliability, validity and fitted GOF degrees of freedom
4.AHL 4.18: further inference and Type I/II errors

examBoundaries.rule: Financial payments occur at period ends. Do not require derivation or recall of the annuity formula; technology may be used. Specify nominal/effective rate and period clearly.
Linear systems have unique solutions. Matrix inverse/determinant may use technology for general n by n matrices; hand calculation only 2 by 2. Matrices are invertible except eigenvector systems.
Exam logarithm-law bases are 10 or e.
Complex quadratics, arithmetic, Argand plots, polar/Euler conversion, integer powers and equal-frequency phasor sums are valid. Finding roots of complex numbers is explicitly excluded.
Eigenvalue/eigenvector calculations are 2 by 2 only. Diagonalization and exact matrix powers use distinct real eigenvalues.
Other models may be introduced in the question; provide all new definitions. Formal continuity is not required. Interpret log-log and semi-log plots, but do not require students to draw those plots.

Give site coordinates for bisector equations. Do not require compass construction of bisectors. Waste-dump optimum is at an intersection of three Voronoi edges; design the region and candidate set so this is actually true.
Do not require memorized exact special-angle values or elaborate trigonometric identities. Numerical/graphical finite-interval trigonometric solutions are valid; ambiguous sine rule is included.

Vector lines, kinematics, angles, components and cross-product areas are valid. Cartesian/vector plane equations are not listed as assumed AI content. General dot/cross-product property proofs are not required.

Adjacency powers count walks. MST uses Prim/Kruskal. Chinese postman is undirected with at most four odd vertices. TSP uses nearest-neighbour upper and deleted-vertex lower bounds on a complete graph; construct shortest-distance completion when necessary. Do not assume Dijkstra as a named required algorithm.

Chi-square tables have at most four rows/columns, degrees of freedom greater than one and expected counts strictly greater than five. Upper-tail tests use 1%,5%,10%; give a critical value when relevant. Fitted GOF parameters reduce degrees of freedom; supply enough raw information to estimate them consistently.

Pooled unpaired two-sample t tests assume normal populations and equal unknown variances. Single-sample and matched-pair differences use t when sigma unknown; use z when known, irrespective of sample size. Do not calculate t critical regions.

Examinable nonlinear regression families are quadratic,cubic,exponential,power,sine plus linear. Residual sums and contextual R-squared interpretation are valid. Do not require the formula R-squared=1-SSres/SStot or choose a model on R-squared alone.

For independent linear combinations add variances with squared coefficients. CLT sample means may use n>30. Normal-mean confidence intervals use z with known sigma, t with unknown sigma; distinguish population spread from standard error.

Poisson model requires independent events and uniform average rate over the relevant interval. Binomial/Poisson inference and discrete critical regions are one-tailed only. Type I/II calculations apply to known-variance normal, binomial and Poisson. For a discrete rejection region maximize Type I probability while keeping it STRICTLY below the stated significance level. Correlation rho=0 tests require given bivariate-normal raw data.

Regular Markov chains; use column states s_n=T^n s_0, T_ij=P(state j to state i). Exact steady states only when requested; normalize the eigenvector for eigenvalue1. Do not use absorbing-chain theory as assumed syllabus content.

Formal analytic limit methods are not assumed. Trapezoidal intervals have equal widths. Standard analytic integration is elementary inspection/substitution. Integration by parts, partial fractions, Taylor/Maclaurin, l'Hopital, Simpson and Runge-Kutta are not assumed AI techniques.

Contextual separable differential equations, slope fields, Euler first-order and coupled systems are valid. Coupled Euler updates must use old simultaneous state values, not sequentially updated values.

Linear phase-portrait systems have distinct nonzero eigenvalues. Qualitative complex/pure-imaginary cases are valid; exact solutions only for distinct real eigenvalues. Second-order differential equations are given in the question. Do not require Jacobian linearization or repeated/zero-eigenvalue theory.

authoringRules: Entirely new wording, contexts, diagrams and data; not source questions with changed numbers.
Attach official SL/AHL references to every question, including common SL content when used at HL.
Every part must have sufficient givens, an unambiguous domain and a matching additive markscheme.
Difficulty should come from modelling decisions, connecting representations, interpreting calculations and justifying conclusions.
Provide needed unfamiliar concepts and scaffold their use; do not disguise an omitted AA topic as assumed AI knowledge.
Code fresh numerical evidence for every part, bounds, alternatives, statistical decisions and global optima; include analytic reasoning for proofs and qualitative results.
Use original scientific SVGs for networks, graph interpretation, geometric models and phase portraits where they improve comprehension.
Preserve the frozen AA collection and its records.
